destroy

Tears down listeners, the rAF loop, and the canvas.

hasWebGpu

Capability gate — navigator.gpu is the WebGPU entry point. Separate from mount so callers can decide without touching the DOM.

(module scope)

Default module loader — dynamic-imports the wasm-pack glue from /wasm/overlay/. /* @vite-ignore * keeps vite from trying to resolve the (build-optional) artifact at bundle time; a 404/missing artifact rejects and the caller falls back. Injectable for tests.

(module scope)

Mounts the overlay canvas + wasm surface on parent, wires the zero-copy input ring, and starts the rAF frame loop. Resolves to a handle, or null when WebGPU/the artifact is unavailable — the DOM remains the authoritative render and interaction layer either way.

  • @param parent Element the canvas is appended to (usually document.body).
  • @param loadModule Injectable module loader (tests substitute a stub).

wire

Attaches the input pump + frame loop to a live wasm surface. Separate from mount so the ring plumbing stays unit-testable without a real GPU.

  • @param overlay Live wasm Overlay instance.
  • @param canvas Mounted canvas the surface draws into.
  • @param memory The module's WebAssembly.Memory (ring + meta live inside).
